posts.subject: My application for admin
posts.bodyHtml:
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
Hello people reading this, this is an apllication for dream knife server. my real name is Sebastian (but everyone calls me basti) and my ingame name is asapbasti 🙂


2) How old are you?
Im 16 years old from january 7th 2017


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
I want to join this administrative team because i love the community and the people playing it. I have always wanted to be an admin because they are respected and
generally kind to other players like a good friend. I also love the knife aspect where its mostly a relaxing thing to play in the backround whilst communicating with friends.


4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have been playing on this server for around 1 and a half years , I have played on this server through two accounts and also taken a few breaks. The fact i have been playing for so long ensures i have a great
knowledge of the server rules and players.


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
My hobbies (excluding gaming)--Im english so i love to play... RUGBY! i also enjoy other sports such as : football,skateboarding and i own my own online shop where i purchase and resell expensive designer clothes.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
Honestly yes, but however i am still only just 16 and i have of course got some immaturity left in me , However i tend to not express my immaturity online in games and more in real
life with friends.


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
Yes i have administrated on an minecraft server with my friend , i did not find it difficult administrating as i am pretty confident and i dont struggle getting people to listen to me


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
I play everyday on dream and recently i only play dream on csgo. I still go to school which is mon-friday and it starts at 8:30am-2:50pm i normally come home and play on dream until 7/8pm. On weekends i play
early in the morning and late at night and depending on the weather ill play midday aswell. Over all id say im a very active player and would keep active when admin.


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?
Firstly i would check to see if the two users are joking around or not if they are i would ask them to kindly keep it a bit quiet (guessing they where annoying other players), If the players weren't joking i would put
the admin rights box explaining to not be rude to other players/admins,and tell him to read the rules if the player carries on i would warn him that i will mute him, And if even then he carries on to call user2 rude
things i would kick him because i had already reminded of the rules and muted him. If he come sback and carries on harrasing i would temp ban for maybe 10 minutes and meanwhile get a higher rank admin to help.


10) Strengths
-I am very active on knife server
-I am friends with alot of the players
-I know most of the players
-I have very good english so i am easy to speak to
-I am not easlity frustrated so i can handle annoying situations easliy
-I have good admin experience
-I own my own succesful business/shop therefore very organised
-I have never been banned on dream only muted twice


11) Weaknesses
-I need a new microphone
-I am quite a young person
-I have schoolwork and school clubs on somedays
-I play ps4 xD
-I can have moments of immaturity (which arent ever that bad)
-Im less active on teamspeak than i am on server / forums.


12) Conclusion / Closing remark
I understand if i dont get the part as i dont feel like alot of the admins dont trust me as much as they could but i will always play on dream and have a healthy attitude.
You know what is coming. MOre forum activity, more stamm on server and then maybe 🙂

1. Your first part is lacking some information: Tell us something about you. Who are you? Where are you from? Waht do you do besides palying games? (Here you could also leave out 5.)


2. So... your birthday is January the 7th, 2001?


3. So you're saying that you want to become an administrator so that everybody will befriend you?


6. I don't see how you tend to joke around with your friends in real life but you wouldn't mess around in a game that you play with (other) friends of yours.


7. I once was an admin myself. I'm not only speaking of co-owning a minecraft server back in the days but I've also been an admin in this community. Therefore, I can confidently claim that administrating one or more CS:GO servers of a fairly big community like Dream is ain't that easy.


9. It's quite hard for me to make out what you're trying to say. Though I believe you'd properly react to the given example. Anyways, this guide could be pretty helpful to any new admin (please notice that @VinceG specifically created these sheets for the Surf-Deathmatch, though the 3rd & 4th row is still applicable to any other server).


10.
"-I am friends with alot of the players"
This is not really a strength as it is no real weakness either. It may cause as many good as bad results.
"-I have very good english so i am easy to speak to"
I somehow can't believe that you are actually from England. Or are you just really NOT trying at all?
"-I have never been banned on dream only muted twice"
I would not call that a strength either. In an actual application you wouldn't bring up the fact that you've never been in prison before but you've been found guilty in minor law cases.


11.
"-I need a new microphone"
It may be fact that your microphone quality sucks but that ain't a weakness of yours.
"-I am quite a young person"
Seeing that you've just turned 16, yes you are relatively young. Though with the minimum age being 16, this should not cause any problems, implying that you're mature.
"-I have schoolwork and school clubs on somedays"
Not a weakness either. Also, most people with normal lifes have things to do daily. (This excludes @Craxto)
"-I play ps4 xD"
You either did not get what is meant by strengths/weaknesses or you just wanted to fill these parts.

From me it's a No for the following reasons



- Forum activity
- Ts3 Activity
- What you posted on forum before
- No forum rules understanding
- Some server rule understanding
- Your application is rather short
- "Admin rights box" ( /msay )
- Admin needs to display the highest maturity available.
- No real strengths mentioned
- Being administrator on Minecraft server is nothing comparing to CS:GO.
